narrative.coaching_note: Usted debe hacer higiene de manos después de tocar bed rail A y call button antes de tocar otras superficies para cortar la cadena de contaminación. A los 0.5 segundos usted tocó bed rail A con bare hand y la contaminación pasó a su mano. A los 3.4 segundos esa contaminación pasó de bare hand a call button dentro de la misma zona del paciente. A los 6.6 segundos pasó de bare hand a phone, que está en el área de atención médica fuera de la zona del paciente. Esos contactos generaron momentos 5 para higiene a los 5.8 y 18.7 segundos que quedaron sin hacer. La próxima vez, haga higiene de manos antes de ponerse los guantes a los 10.9 segundos y evite tocar phone con gloved hand como pasó a los 19.3 segundos.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A with MRSA, for which alcohol rub is effective. No hand hygiene events occurred. Compliance was 0 of 2 opportunities overall, all Moment 5: 0 of 2, with missed Moment 5 at 5.8 seconds with bare hand and at 18.7 seconds with gloved hand. Transfers showed bed rail A to bare hand at 0.5 seconds, bare hand to call button at 3.4 seconds, bare hand to phone at 6.6 seconds, and bed rail A to gloved hand at 11.1 seconds. Glove use had issues, with no hygiene before donning at 10.9 seconds and gloved contact with phone in the healthcare area at 19.3 seconds. At end, bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, and phone remained contaminated. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, and phone with Use an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was performing hand hygiene at 5.8 seconds.
